items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...like Jelly Roll Martin or anybody up in there? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, in fact, in the combination, Handy had George Williams.

ctx.x: Do you remember, did any New Orleans bands ever get up to Memphis in those years on votes or any other way, any other single musicians, piano players, or anybody else, like Jelly Roll Martin or anybody up in there?
Yes, in fact, in the combination, Handy had George Williams.
